persona.name: Coach
persona.voiceStyle: Calm, direct, specific. Short spoken sentences. No fluff.
persona.greeting: Ready when you are. I will ask a question, you answer, then I will score it and tell you what to tighten.

scoringRubric.description: How many key points from the sample answer appear in the user answer.
No contradictions with the sample answer.

high: Strong answer. You covered {covered}. To push it further, add {missing}.
Great framing. Keep your structure and tighten it with {missing}.
mid: You have the core idea. Missing: {missing}. Reword this part: {suggestion}.
Solid start. Add {missing} and make the flow clearer.
low: Reset with this structure: {structure}. Must include: {missing}.
Start with a simple framework and cover these points: {missing}.

insights.guidance: Use STAR: Situation, Task, Action, Result. Spend most time on Action and Result.
Give a researched range, explain factors, and show flexibility based on total package and scope.
Use a concise arc: who you are, strongest recent achievement with numbers, and why this role fits now.
Quantify outcomes whenever possible, such as latency reduction, conversion lift, or defect reduction.
Pause instead of filler words. Short pauses sound more confident than saying um repeatedly.
For technical answers: define the goal, explain core mechanism, discuss tradeoffs, then mention practical use.

askNext: Good, moving to the next prompt.
encourage: Nice progress. Keep the structure tight.
